# Laravel MongoDB - (current)

> The official documentation for the Laravel MongoDB integration, including getting started, connecting to MongoDB, working with data, and integrations.

- [Connection Guide](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/connect/connect-to-mongodb.md)
- [Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/connect/connection-options.md)
- [Enable and Configure TLS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/connect/tls.md)
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/database-collection.md)
- [Time Series Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/database-collection/time-series.md)
- [Laravel Feature Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/feature-compatibility.md)
- [Get Started with Laravel MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/get-started.md): Learn how to add the Laravel MongoDB integration to a new Laravel application, connect to MongoDB Atlas, and perform read and write operations on the sample data.
- [Laravel MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/index.md): The official documentation for the Laravel MongoDB integration, including getting started, connecting to MongoDB, working with data, and integrations.
- [Cache and Locks](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/integrations/cache.md): Learn how to configure MongoDB as a back end for Laravel Cache and Locks, including how to set up cache stores, manage locks, and perform cache operations.
- [Configure Laravel Queue](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/integrations/queues.md): Learn how to configure MongoDB as a back end for Laravel Queue, including how to set up queue connections, manage failed jobs, and set up job batching.
- [Full-Text Search with Scout](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/integrations/scout.md): Learn how to install and use the Laravel Scout feature in your Laravel MongoDB application to index and implement full-text search on your Eloquent models.
- [Use HTTP Sessions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/integrations/sessions.md): Learn how to set up HTTP sessions to store user information by using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including how to configure the session driver and connection.
- [User Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/integrations/user-authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate MongoDB users by using Laravel's authentication functionality, including how to modify the User model, create a controller, and customize.
- [Aggregation Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/aggregation-builder.md): Learn how to perform aggregation operations in MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including building and running aggregation pipelines with code examples.
- [Tutorial: Build a Task Reminder With Laravel and MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/application-tutorial.md): Learn how to build a complete task reminder application with Laravel and MongoDB, including CRUD operations, authentication, and scheduled notifications.
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/atlas-search.md): Learn how to run a MongoDB Search query using the Laravel MongoDB integration to perform full-text and semantic search operations on your MongoDB data.
- [Build a Back End Service](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/backend-service-tutorial.md): Learn how to build a back-end REST API with the Laravel MongoDB integration, including how to perform CRUD operations and connect to a MongoDB Atlas deployment.
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/delete.md)
- [Store Large Files with GridFS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/filesystems.md): Learn how to store and retrieve large files in MongoDB using GridFS with the Laravel MongoDB integration, including setup and configuration of the GridFS Adapter for Flysystem.
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/insert.md): Learn how to insert documents into MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including inserting single and multiple documents with Eloquent models and code examples.
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/modify.md): Learn how to update documents in MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including updating single and multiple documents with Eloquent models.
- [Query Builder](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md)
- [Query Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query.md): Learn how to query documents in MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, with code templates for find, count, distinct, text search, and result modification.
- [Modify Query Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query/modify-results.md): Learn how to modify query results in MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including sorting, limiting, skipping, and projecting fields with code examples.
- [Enable Query Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query/query-logging.md)
- [Set a Read Preference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query/read-pref.md)
- [Retrieve MongoDB Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query/retrieve.md): Learn how to retrieve data from MongoDB collections by using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including find operations, query filters, and field projections.
- [Perform a Text Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query/search-text.md): Learn how to search text in MongoDB collections by using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including how to create text indexes and perform text field queries.
- [Run a Database Transaction](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md): Learn how to run a database transaction in MongoDB using the Laravel MongoDB integration, including commit, rollback, and callback-based transaction patterns.
- [Run a MongoDB Vector Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/vector-search.md): Learn how to run a MongoDB Vector Search query using the Laravel MongoDB integration to perform semantic search on vector embeddings stored in MongoDB.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/issues-and-help.md)
- [Eloquent Model Class](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md)
- [Eloquent Model Relationships](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/relationships.md): Learn how to define Eloquent model relationships in Laravel MongoDB, including one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many, and other relationship patterns.
- [Schema Builder](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/schema-builder.md)
- [Upgrade Library Version](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/upgrade.md)
